title: The Lotus Sutra, Part 5
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: The Soto Zen dharma talk explores how the Buddha's teachings can help us rediscover our inner wealth and dignity through mindfulness and practice, particularly by cultivating great forgiveness and acceptance of ourselves and others. The Lotus Sutra is highlighted as a key text that encourages us to see true freedom lies not in achieving a specific goal, but in the journey itself. By embracing imperfections and cultural limitations, we can find inspiration and guidance for living a more authentic and compassionate life.
